skill.summary: 邮件指令定时处理任务。通过 IMAP/SMTP 自动接收并执行邮件中的指令，以邮件形式回复执行结果。适用于：(1) 创建定时任务监控指定邮箱 (2) 通过邮件下发指令给 AI Agent (3) 实现邮件驱动的自动化工作流。需配置：收件邮箱、SMTP/IMAP 配置、指令发件人白名单。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of email-cron-handler:

- Automates processing of command emails via IMAP/SMTP and replies with execution results.
- Supports scheduled mailbox monitoring, sender whitelisting, and execution status feedback (success/failure/timeout).
- Provides example configuration and documentation for quick setup.
- Includes scripts for fetching, replying to, and marking processed emails.
